rationale: Recent anchor-refresh and carry curriculum edits regressed hard, while recurrent-tail plus export-aware training remains the strongest local motif. This run keeps the current 9x512 reverse-tail family intact but narrows late quant-aware roundtrip pressure to the tensors most likely to matter for final int8+zlib behavior: embedding, tail QKV, and late projection weights. It also aligns the EMA tracker with that same export-critical subset instead of broadly perturbing the whole model during the endgame. The hypothesis is that selective export alignment preserves throughput and the winning recurrent-tail dynamics better than full-state roundtrip regularization, while still training directly toward the exact final metric.
title: Targeted Tail Export Curriculum
